offering_description.value: Operates digital wholesale used-vehicle marketplaces connecting dealers, commercial consignors, OEMs and fleets as buyers and sellers. Also provides vehicle inspection, transport and auction-related financing services. Revenue comes mainly from fees on vehicle transactions and related services.

primary_services.value: online wholesale vehicle auctions; vehicle inspection and condition reporting; vehicle transportation and logistics; floorplan and auto finance; dealer data and remarketing tools

customer_segment.value: B2B: franchise and independent used-car dealers, rental companies, fleet owners, lenders, OEMs and commercial consignors

end_markets.value: automotive remarketing; used vehicle wholesale; auto finance; vehicle fleets and leasing

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: buyer and seller fees on vehicles sold through auctions and marketplaces; service fees: inspection, transport, reconditioning and title services; interest or premiums: interest and fees on dealer floorplan financing
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: digital marketplace matching vehicle sellers with dealer buyers; service provider: inspection, logistics and related services supporting vehicle remarketing; financial intermediary: floorplan financing for dealer purchases
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico, with some European presence

specialization.value: related lines: wholesale auction marketplaces, logistics and inspection services, and dealer finance

distribution_channels.value: online: digital auction platforms and mobile apps for dealers; direct sales: account teams serving commercial consignors and dealers; own locations: physical auction and inspection sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: auto auction and dealer licensing, title and consumer lending rules, state motor vehicle regulators, data privacy

notes: Business mix may have changed after recent divestitures, such as the US physical auction business, so details are uncertain.
